name: GrapeCompare
tagline: See the difference. Keep the context.
description: GrapeCompare is a private, native comparison workspace for macOS. Every comparison runs locally. The app has no account, analytics, advertising, tracking, network entitlement, or cloud upload.
store_description:
GrapeCompare is a private, native comparison workspace for macOS. Every comparison runs locally. The app has no account, analytics, advertising, tracking, network entitlement, or cloud upload.

FOLDERS
• Scan folders recursively without following symbolic links.
• Filter identical, changed, left-only, and right-only items.
• Review safe copy, replace, move, and recoverable delete operations before execution.
• Use preflight checks, progress, cancellation, transaction history, and validated undo.

FILES
• Compare text line by line and character by character.
• Navigate differences, search both sides, apply reusable comparison rules, edit an output, and export a unified patch.
• Compare JSON, property lists, XCStrings, and Xcode project files semantically.

IMAGES AND DEVELOPER FORMATS
• Inspect images side by side, overlaid, split, blinking, or as a difference heatmap.
• View metadata and pixel-level difference measurements.
• Inspect app bundles, code signatures, entitlements, provisioning profiles, Mach-O architectures, and asset catalogs without launching inspected code.

MERGE
• Resolve user-selected three-way text and image merges.
• Choose conflict results individually or in bulk and export the completed result.

GrapeCompare requires macOS 15 or later. It uses App Sandbox and accesses only files and folders you explicitly select. Finder Open With, drag and drop, recent comparisons, and a Compare Files Shortcut are supported.

name: Folucent
tagline: Read deeply. Keep what you learn.
description: Folucent is a quiet place to read PDFs and keep what you learn.
store_description:
Folucent is a quiet place to read PDFs and keep what you learn.

READ WITH THE SOURCE CLOSE
Import PDFs from Files, pick up where you left off, search passages, and keep bookmarks. Choose a grid or list library. Use two-page reading when space allows and keyboard shortcuts with a connected keyboard.

WORK WITH SCANNED PAGES
Recognize text in page images, review the result, and use it in learning tools. Recognized page text is saved locally and can be found through search. The PDF keeps its original page layout.

UNDERSTAND A PASSAGE
Open Understand to explain a selected passage or the current text page. Keep the source collapsed while reading the explanation, expand it when needed, or choose Translate. After an explanation, use Ask about this passage to clarify a specific point. Choose Apple's on-device AI, Apple Private Cloud Compute, or your own OpenAI-compatible service. Custom services require an HTTPS address, model ID, API key and explicit permission to send text to that endpoint. The key stays in this device's Keychain; service availability, privacy and charges depend on the provider. Services never switch automatically. The included guide also offers clearly labelled built-in study examples. Learning actions use selected passages, not an entire book.

KEEP YOUR OWN UNDERSTANDING
Write what an idea means to you, save a study note, and return to its source page. Search across PDF text, recognized text, highlights, and notes. Revisit notes through the review queue.

FOLUCENT PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Optional Pro adds on-device whole-PDF translation with page-by-page progress and source comparison, cross-book study collections, PDF and Markdown study guides, saved guide templates, PDF reading aloud with sentence and paragraph controls, and a gold icon. Listen in the background on iPhone and iPad. iPhone/iPad can change the Home Screen icon; Mac customizes the running Dock icon only. Reading, annotations, OCR, notes, AI settings and standard exports remain free. Pro includes no AI credits; third-party AI fees are separate.

MAKE THE SPACE YOURS
Start with a neutral interface or choose an optional color theme. Use light or dark appearance and larger text. On iPad, add handwriting to pages.

No account is required. Your library and notes are stored locally. Apple AI requires compatible hardware and supported system settings; PCC and custom services require network access. Unsupported or unconfigured AI actions are hidden while reading and notes remain available. App-level CloudKit sync is not configured. The interface supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish. Answer and translation languages can be chosen independently from the same eight options; support depends on the selected model. AI output requires comparison with the source.
home_image_alt: Folucent passage explanation beside the source

description: Remoboard turns your computer browser into a keyboard for your iPhone or iPad. Type in a text field on your device from a Mac, Windows, or Linux computer on the same Wi-Fi network. No desktop app or account is required.
store_description:
Remoboard turns your computer browser into a keyboard for your iPhone or iPad. Type in a text field on your device from a Mac, Windows, or Linux computer on the same Wi-Fi network. No desktop app or account is required.

Getting started
1. Add the Remoboard keyboard in iOS or iPadOS Settings and allow Full Access for local network access.
2. Switch to the Remoboard keyboard in any text field. Open the URL shown on the keyboard in your computer browser.
3. If PIN pairing is enabled (on by default), enter the six-digit code shown on the keyboard, then start typing.

Features
• Smoother Chinese and other composed text input.
• Automatic reconnection and clear connection status.
• Reusable phrases for text you type often.
• Browser controls for text entry and clipboard actions.
• Light and dark appearance, with support for 10 languages.

Both devices must be on the same local network. Full Access lets the keyboard serve its local page.

Remoboard Pro (optional one-time purchase) adds snippets, text expansion, trusted computers, image clipboard, split sending, send history and themes. Everything else is free.

description: BabelTable helps two people speak across a language barrier, right across the table. Speech recognition and translation run on your device using Apple’s Speech and Translation frameworks.
store_description:
BabelTable helps two people speak across a language barrier, right across the table. Speech recognition and translation run on your device using Apple’s Speech and Translation frameworks.

SPEAK FACE TO FACE
Place your iPhone or iPad between you. The opposite-facing panels let each person read from their side of the table. Prefer sitting together? Switch to the chat layout for a shared conversation view.

PREPARE ONCE, TRANSLATE OFFLINE
Download the speech and translation models for your chosen languages while connected to the internet. Once prepared, supported language pairs work offline. No OpenAI account, API key, or cloud translation service is required.

TAKE TURNS NATURALLY
Select the language of the person speaking, then talk. Read the original captions and the translated text. Switch the speaking language when it is the other person’s turn.

HEAR IT, SHOW IT
Tap the speaker next to any translation to read it aloud with the voices installed on your device. Show a translation full screen in large type, and turn it around for the person across from you.

ON IPHONE DUO
Unfold for two panes: each person's side face to face, or the whole conversation beside the newest translation in large type. Half open, the fold becomes the gap between panes, so no words sit on it. Folded, everything works on the outer display.

KEEP YOUR CONVERSATIONS
Search the full text of every saved conversation, star the ones that matter, and share a text transcript when you choose. Conversation archives are stored locally on your device.

FREE EVERY DAY, PRO WHEN YOU NEED MORE
Translation is free for 2 hours a day. BabelTable Pro removes the daily limit with a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly or monthly subscription, and adds tools for travel and work:
• Auto read-aloud: every finished translation is spoken for the other person
• Phrasebook: common phrases in all 13 languages, plus your own
• Bilingual PDF export with what was said and its translation side by side
• Conversation summaries created on your device by Apple Intelligence
• Color themes and alternate app icons
Pro still runs entirely on your device.

REQUIREMENTS
Requires iOS 27 or later and a device and language pair supported by Apple’s on-device speech recognition and translation. Initial model preparation requires an internet connection and available storage. Language availability varies. Speakers take turns and select their language; overlapping speech is not separated. Read-aloud uses voices installed on your device. Summaries require a device with Apple Intelligence turned on.

name: Foxwick
tagline: Carry the light. Find your next adventure.
store_description:
Carry the light.

Foxwick is a bright, hand-crafted pixel action adventure for your phone. Pick a class, roll through danger, strike at the right moment and light the way, one campfire at a time.

TWENTY STAGES, TWENTY BOSSES
Travel from the Glimmer Fields to the Bell Tower Summit, then on past the wonders of the Earth to the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury and the surface of the Sun. Every stage ends with a boss that has its own look, its own rhythm and its own weak moment. Learn the pattern, then beat it.

The first ten stages, through the Bell Tower Summit, are free. One purchase, the Full Journey, opens stages 11 to 20, and with them the twenty-boss Rush, New Journey+ and the deepest Ember Trial bosses.

THREE CLASSES, ONE SET OF CONTROLS
- Samurai: steady steps and clean cuts.
- Mage: keep your distance and send the fire.
- Assassin: quick feet. Never be where it lands.
Same simple touch controls for all three: a stick on the left to move and jump, and Attack, Roll, Mending Vial and your skills on the right.

SKILLS AND ULTIMATES
Skill tomes wait along the road: rising cuts, meteors, smoke bombs, chain lightning and more, ten for each class. Equip three and swap them from the pause menu or the stage map. Fight to fill the gauge, then unleash an ultimate that takes over the whole screen: Hundred Blades, Meteor Storm, Shadow Massacre and six more to win from bosses.

MORE ROADS TO RUN
Raise skills to rank III, win charms and stage medals, shop at the fox's camp, and take on the Boss Rush, the Ember Trial, the Daily Trial and New Journey+.

HITS THAT FEEL GOOD
Every strike has a short pause, a flash, a push back and a spray of sparks. Heavy hits and boss hits land even harder. Haptic feedback on supported iPhones.

MANAGE YOUR STAMINA
Attacking and rolling cost stamina. Roll through an attack at the right moment to take no damage. Run out, and you have to step back.

REST AT THE CAMPFIRE
Campfires save your progress and refill your Mending Vials. Resting brings the monsters back, so choose when to stop.

FALL, RECOVER, TRY AGAIN
When you fall, you drop your Embers where it happened. Get back to them and take them back. Fall again first, and they are gone.

MADE TO PLAY ANYWHERE
- Plays fully offline.
- No account needed. Game Center achievements and leaderboards are there if you want them.
- No ads and no subscriptions. Stages 1 to 10 are free; the Full Journey is a single one-time purchase.
- Your progress is saved on your device.

Light the fire. Carry the light.

name: TabCarry
tagline: Save your tabs. Come back ready.
description: Save and restore Chrome windows, tabs and groups. Search saved sessions, keep local backups, and continue where you left off.

features.title: Keep your place
features.body: Save named sessions with window structure, tab order, pinned tabs and Chrome groups.

features.title: Find it again
features.body: Search saved sessions and restore a full workspace or selected tabs.

features.title: Local backups
features.body: Export and import JSON backups. No account or cloud service is required.

name: NotbadBookmark
tagline: Find your links. Keep them organized.
description: A free bookmark manager with folders, tags, search, import and export. Organize bookmarks and keep your own backups.

features.title: Search and filter
features.body: Find bookmarks by title, URL, folder, domain or tag.

features.title: Organize your library
features.body: Work with folders and tags, switch between list and grid views, and manage selected bookmarks together.

features.title: Back up and recover
features.body: Import and export bookmarks, and use local recovery snapshots for deletion recovery.

name: X Article Export
tagline: Keep the article. Choose your format.
description: Export X Articles to readable PDFs or Markdown, preserving headings, code, images, links and math where available.

features.title: PDF and Markdown
features.body: Create a printable document or a Markdown file from the article you choose.

features.title: Preserve structure
features.body: Keep headings, code, quotes, links and images instead of taking screenshots.

features.title: Export on demand
features.body: Runs when you invoke the extension on the current tab. No developer-operated backend.
